contains_promotion.instructions: Does this email contain a concrete promotion, discount, reward, free benefit, or limited-time savings opportunity that a recipient could act on? Treat food, shopping, travel, events, services, subscriptions, and other categories equally. Do not count ordinary receipts, account notices, editorial newsletters, or invitations without a concrete benefit as promotions.

criteria.true: A concrete savings opportunity, discount, reward, free item, credit, or limited-time deal is stated.
criteria.false: No actionable promotion or savings opportunity is stated.

promotion_category.instructions: Which category best describes the concrete promotion in this email? Choose other when the message is promotional but does not fit the listed categories.

criteria.food: Restaurants, groceries, meal delivery, drinks, or dining.
criteria.shopping: Retail goods, clothing, electronics, books, or merchandise.
criteria.travel: Hotels, flights, transportation, attractions, or travel packages.
criteria.events: Tickets, concerts, festivals, workshops, or conferences.
criteria.services: Software, cloud, memberships, classes, or other services.
criteria.other: A concrete promotion that fits none of the categories above.
